outcome: Finance owner/admin can export immutable, mapped, balanced journal evidence into trial QuickBooks/Xero or general CSV without exposing accounting records to staff or sending provider writes.
risk: Immutable financial export, protected readback, safe CSV injection handling and target-specific mapping/date/currency correctness; no external provider API calls.
next: Complete full K-5 implementation and exact-head CI/review; proceed in order to K-6 depreciation.

references.purpose: Keep K-2 read-only month review unchanged.
Finish/reject source posting before snapshotting export.

invariants: OWNER/ADMIN only, live role verification on all export and download paths
No CSV formula injection or secret leakage
No duplicate accounting external import by silent overwrite
No money-out or provider API activation
sequence: Pure target-specific CSV formatting and currency/date guard
Bounded source post and transactionally consistent entries/maps
OWNER/ADMIN screen and protected download history
acceptance: OWNER/ADMIN can request QBO_JOURNAL_CSV, XERO_JOURNAL_CSV, GENERIC_JOURNAL_CSV or CASH_MOVEMENTS_CSV exports with a validated inclusive Colorado from/to range, DETAIL or DAILY_SUMMARY mode, and an optional already-exported filter; STAFF/CUSTOMER and inactive identities are refused by the domain and every route.

Before export, bounded source posting completes without errors; the export refuses uninitialized books, invalid/oversized dates, unsettled posting exceptions, unbalanced journals and any missing or inactive used-account mappings. No guessed account names or company credentials, no external accounting API.

Every target produces source-defined stable exact headers, dates, account mappings, integer-cent decimal amounts and safe spreadsheet-text escaping; QBO entry numbers/dates, Xero sign/account/tax columns, generic detailed journal and cash-movements category allocation have distinct tested formatters.

DETAIL contains all eligible source entries in stable date/entryNumber order; DAILY_SUMMARY nets each day's debit and credit per ledger account and remains balanced. Stripe payout skip settings are target-specific and the onlyNotYetExported filter is target-scoped, not globally suppressing a source.

Successful exports persist immutable ExportBatch bytes and SHA-256, bounded journal-entry provenance, output filename and creator; concurrent same-criteria requests and replay with onlyNotYetExported do not create duplicate exported entry identities, and existing export content never changes when mappings or source journals later change.

Owner/admin Books screen supports target/mode/date/filter, unmapped-account guidance and read-only export history with secure re-download; CSV GET enforces live authenticated accounting roles and no-store content headers. Existing /desk/books/export?month review remains working and unchanged.

Disposable PostgreSQL tests cover authorization, mapping and date guards, retries/concurrency, locked source batches, hash/byte integrity, cutoff and target scopes; focused formatter unit tests cover all target headers, daily net/cash allocations, payout flags and formula injection, and browser/axe/regression CI validates Books and export navigation. Maintain roadmap/owner guide/database/status and explicit real-provider trial-import acceptance.
